title: Kyle's character: a Vigilant of Stendarr
description: Kyle's own character for our Skyrim Together campaign: a Vigilant of Stendarr from Cyrodiil. Lore, how to play him, the nearest shrine to Helgen, and story hooks.
lead: This is Kyle's own character. Everyone else plays their own.
He is a man from Cyrodiil and a Vigilant of Stendarr. He walks north to find his order.
Each fact below says where it came from. What we have not checked says so.

grids.title: At a glance
rows: A man. A Vigilant of Stendarr, from Cyrodiil.
On the road north into Skyrim, near Helgen. He is not escaping Helgen's execution.
To reach his order, or get back to it. A Stendarr shrine can be his base.
Maybe not. It may start scattered. A couple of us may meet in a town.
Healer first. He keeps the party alive before he attacks.

grids.title: Lore: what the Vigil believes and does
grids.note: The clip is one fan's video analysis, not game text. Rows marked The clip only are its reading.
rows: The Vigil hunts abominations: Daedra, werewolves, vampires and witches. The old doctrine names four kinds: Daedra, man-beasts, risen dead and vampires.
Daedra and their worshippers worry the Vigil most. It treats vampires as a lesser threat. It shows no mercy to abominations.
Four precepts. Never refuse aid you can give. Go among the sick and wounded. Pray every day. Do not hoard wealth or indulge.
The order grew from fear after the Oblivion Crisis. It hates conjuring and necromancy. Healing and holy magic are its own. The clip only.
Vigilants walk the roads in groups and patrol the wilds. Any Vigilant who is not fighting will cure your disease if you ask. It costs nothing.
The Hall is a lodge and a monastery. Members eat, read and pray there. Some dig up old ruins and write notes. The clip only.

grids.title: Lore: what a Vigilant must know
grids.note: Yes, the clip names alchemy, restoration and destruction. It says Vigilants must learn all three and fight with maces. It gives no game source for must.
rows: Must learn it. The Hall has two alchemy labs.
Each Vigilant carries healing potions and a cure disease potion.
Must learn it. Healing is their trade.
Every Vigilant knows the Healing spell.
Must learn it. The clip says they add fire magic to the mace.
The list shows no fire spell for a Skyrim Vigilant. The clip only.
Each Vigilant carries a mace. It gets better as they level.
They cast a protective armor spell before a fight.
Every Vigilant knows Oakflesh and Lesser Ward.
They know a little of everything. Few master any of it. The clip only.

grids.title: Lore: history
rows: The Vigil was founded soon after the Oblivion Crisis of 3E 433. Older Stendarr orders came before it.
The Hall of the Vigilant is south of Dawnstar. A second base, Stendarr's Beacon, is a tower in The Rift. Keeper Carcette leads.
Both left the Vigil, unhappy with it. Isran thought it too soft. They founded the Dawnguard.
In the Dawnguard story, vampires destroy the Hall. Tolan and Adalvald die at Dimhollow Crypt. Tolan tells Isran that Carcette is dead.
The Vigil goes on. Most members already live on the road. Stendarr's Beacon is still a base.

grids.title: Playing him: the build
rows: Heal others first. Keep the party standing.
The Vigil's other disciplines, from the clip.
All are Allowed on the rules page. Healing other players in co-op is not fully tested.

grids.title: Heavy armor and spells
grids.note: Read from the installed plugin files on 2026-10-05. Not yet tested in play. Not checked: one Imperious perk for High Elves tests armor type.
rows: No. We found nothing in the installed plugins that does that to Restoration or Destruction.
Does heavy armor raise spell cost?
No. The spell-cost perks do not check what armor you wear.
Is any spell tied to armor?
One group. Oakflesh, Ironflesh, Stoneflesh, Ebonyflesh and Dragonhide lose their Mage Armor bonus while you wear any light or heavy armor. The spell still works. It is the same rule as the base game.
More armor. Perks add 20% to 100% more rating, 25% more with three heavy pieces, and 25% more with three matching pieces. Three pieces also halve fall damage and reflect some melee hits.
Perk points in the Heavy Armor tree. The Conditioning perk text says heavy armor then weighs nothing and does not slow you, so it weighs and slows without it. We have not measured that.
What does light armor give instead?
Matching light perks add armor, stamina regeneration and arrow deflection. One adds 30% spell duration with two matching elven or falmer light pieces.
The bonuses count three pieces of one kind. Keep three heavy pieces to keep the heavy bonuses. That is read from the perk text, not tested.

grids.title: Playing him: perks that fit
grids.note: Perk text is from Better Vanilla Perks as installed. Our own patch changes a few perks.
rows: Mace attacks deal 20%, 40% or 60% more damage to armor and undead.
Take 50% less power-attack damage while shield blocking.
Novice to Expert: spells of that level cost half the magicka, and you gain magicka regeneration. Respite makes healing spells restore stamina too.
Our patch rewrites it to 10% less magicka for Restoration spells.
Spells of each level cost half the magicka and are 20% to 50% stronger. Augmented Flames cuts fire spell cost by 20%.
Potions and poisons are 20% to 100% stronger. Benefactor adds 25% to good potions.

grids.title: Shrines and the road
grids.note: A cell is one square of the game map. Distances are straight lines, measured by us from the game data in our install.
rows: Whiterun Hold, on the tundra. South of Swindler's Den, northeast of Broken Fang Cave. A Zenithar shrine is in sight to the west.
The Pale, on a table inside the Hall, south of Dawnstar. The shrine goes when the Dawnguard quest starts and the Hall is destroyed.
The Rift, in the Captain's Quarter, on a dresser. North-northwest of Riften. Bandits and frostbite spiders live there.
The Rift, in a tower's sleeping quarters. The Vigil still uses it, even after the Dawnguard story.
The big temple in Solitude, with the other Divines.

grids.title: The closest shrine to Helgen
rows: The Two Pillars, in Whiterun Hold.
About 23 cells in a straight line. About 33 cells walking from town to town.
The Blessing of Stendarr: block 10% more damage with your shield, for 8 hours. It also cures disease. That is the base game. We have not re-read it in our install.
Could the Hall be his base instead?
Yes, until the Dawnguard quest starts. Then it burns. Stendarr's Beacon is the shrine that survives, but it is far to the east.

grids.title: The road from Helgen
grids.note: UESP gives positions, not the bends of the road. We have not walked the road.
rows: Eastern Falkreath Hold, south of Riverwood. He is on the road north, near here.
North, about 8 cells. It has an alchemy lab. It is south of Whiterun.
Go west from Whiterun toward Rorikstead. The shrine is about 16 cells due west of Whiterun.
East of Rorikstead. Bandits live there. The shrine is south of it.
A raised stone platform with the shrine between two standing pillars. A strong box sits beside it.
Southwest of the shrine. Skeletons and vampires live inside. Minimum level 6.

grids.title: People he might meet
rows: Leads the Vigil in Skyrim, from the Hall. In the Dawnguard story Tolan says she is dead.
A Redguard and a former Vigilant. He leads the Dawnguard at Fort Dawnguard. He trains Heavy Armor.
A Breton and a former Vigilant. A vampire hunter at Fort Dawnguard.
An Imperial priest who believes Arkay speaks through him. He worked with the Vigil and is rescued at Ruunvald. He trains Restoration.

grids.title: Story hooks
rows: Vigilants walk in groups. He meets two and asks after the Hall.
Do they know where Carcette is?
He prays at the Two Pillars and heals the party. Vampires wait in the cave below.
Does the party follow him in?
The Hall stands until the Dawnguard quest starts. He races to reach it.
Isran left the Vigil and called it too soft. He is looking for recruits.
